text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Nice work, Nice Nature!
That was a great run!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
I had my doubts without Teio here, but...
Nice Nature is doing pretty well herself!
The voices from the stands after the race were proof that Nice Nature had truly run "her own race." And then—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I... I really ran my own race, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness... Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
With a result like this at the Kikuka Sho, there are no complaints!
You worked extraordinarily hard!
choice_data_list: Then, you get the "Good Effort Award"!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer-san's
handmade trophy!

The origami trophy I gave Nice Nature at the Kokura Kinen to help boost her confidence.
Since she seemed to look forward to it before, I made another one, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...You really made it for me.
Hehe, I'm still feeling wiped out, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All right.
Shall we hold a presentation ceremony later?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: To celebrate Nature-san's success♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Or so I got carried away saying. If Teio were here,
things probably wouldn't have gone this way, though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if Teio's okay. How bad is her injury...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even for her,
I bet she's feeling pretty down right now...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Nn... Yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Come on, it's Teio. I'm sure she'll bounce right back, saying 'I'm invincible, after all!' or something.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Until then, I've gotta make sure
I get a little stronger too.
choice_data_list: The big showdown is still ahead!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
A major showdown, at this time of year with winter so close?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah!
Could it be...?!"
choice_data_list: Why don't we aim for the "Arima Kinen"?
Want to aim for the "Arima Kinen"?

text_block_list.text:
Having displayed her true strength at the Kikuka Sho, Nice Nature has a diehard fan base.
As she is now, she can challenge the Arima Kinen!

Besides, this year's most notable Umamusume
will be running in the Arima Kinen.
Racing against them is sure to bring further growth.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen, huh...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
To repay everyone who always cheers for me,
there's no better stage... is there?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...It might be impossible.
Even if I run, I might not stand a chance, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —I want to run in the Arima Kinen!

And so, the final race of the Classic Class
was decided to be the Arima Kinen!
